publicSeams.description: Platform integration entry point for notification delivery routing.
Cross-feature seam for durable outbound email creation and resend flows.
Provider-neutral async email delivery seam and job-type registration for jobProcessing workers.
Shared notification-delivery error base for transport-layer handling.

dependsOn.description: Registers notification email jobs and exposes an async queued writer through the provider-neutral job-processing seam.

breakingChangeRisks: Changing the notification email writer contract can break features that delegate onboarding or verification email delivery through this seam.
Changing outbound email persistence or resend semantics can affect auditability and historical correctness for feature-owned workflows.

Queued email delivery must not send redacted durable snapshots as provider content; security-sensitive emails require owner-regenerated content or synchronous delivery until a richer async content model is approved.
